Pakistan's Test record here is quite pleasing and they will be eyeing to keep it going. Kane Williamson is all set to lead his side for the first time at home. Both these sides have some quality fast bowlers in their ranks and with the pitch in all likelihood to assist them, the ideal decision will be to win the toss and have a go with the cherry. Plenty to look forward to as the all-important toss is coming up in a very short while. NOTE - Due to lack of television feed there won't be commentary available for this match but we will provide you with the final summary of the day's play...

Hello and a warm welcome for the first Test match between New Zealand and Pakistan at Hagley Oval, Christchurch. Before anything else, let me tell you what you are eagerly waiting for. It is bright and sunny out there and it is expected to stay the same way. After a wet day 1, this is the start we all wanted.
